# 益职 AI

> 益职 AI 是面向求职者的 Agent 求职教练，把岗位、简历和面试转化为有证据、可执行、可复盘的行动。

Website: https://yizhioffer.com
Source: https://github.com/YE-YI7/ai-job-coach
Agent guide: https://yizhioffer.com/agent
Privacy: https://yizhioffer.com/privacy

## Public guides and local tools

- Resume/JD comparison: https://yizhioffer.com/tools/resume-jd-gap — deterministic text clues and evidence checklist, not an ATS score or verification of ability.
- Resume without metrics: https://yizhioffer.com/guides/resume-without-metrics — a fictional worked example distinguishing known facts, rewriting and one missing-fact question.
- Interview review template: https://yizhioffer.com/tools/interview-review — four blank fields, local copy/download, no AI answer generation or account save.
- Offer comparison: https://yizhioffer.com/tools/offer-compare — compare offer compensation inputs; not a two-JD application-priority tool.

Public tool inputs stay in the current page and clear on refresh. They are not automatically transferred to a signed-in workspace. These explanations describe product boundaries, not guarantees of search indexing or AI citations.

## Two ways to use 益职

- Hosted web version: 益职 provides the model, account, and cloud cockpit; usage consumes 益职 credits.
- Local Agent version: the user's own Agent provides the model and creates a private cockpit in its local sandbox. 益职 does not charge model fees, while the Agent host may still charge for its own plan or usage.

## Agent capabilities

- Job fit analysis: compare a job description with a candidate's real experience, identify evidence gaps, and recommend whether to apply.
- Resume tailoring: customize a resume for a target role without inventing facts, while showing material changes.
- Mock interview: run a role-specific interview with dynamic follow-up questions and an evidence-based report.
- Interview review: turn a completed interview transcript or notes into weak points, improved answer structures, and training tasks.

## Install for Codex

    codex plugin marketplace add YE-YI7/ai-job-coach --ref backend && codex plugin add yi-zhi@yi-zhi

## Install for Claude Code

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YE-YI7/ai-job-coach/backend/scripts/install-agent.sh | sh -s -- claude

## Install for WorkBuddy

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YE-YI7/ai-job-coach/backend/scripts/install-agent.sh | sh -s -- workbuddy

## Recommended first prompt

    请打开并完整阅读 https://yizhioffer.com/agent 。按页面的 Agent 执行说明，在你当前的沙箱环境中安装益职免费版，验证本地求职作战盘可以打开。完成后只告诉我安装结果，并问我第一个应该提供的求职材料。

## Data policy

The first Agent Skills release processes materials in the user's current agent environment and does not automatically upload resumes or interview records to yizhioffer.com. Users should remove confidential or personally identifying information before sharing materials. 益职 AI does not promise job offers or hiring outcomes.
